image_cves.title: harfbuzz: allows attackers to trigger O(n^2) growth via consecutive marks

image_cves.exposure_assessment: User document text reaches Chromium rendering; text shaping is an exposed parser surface.
image_cves.recommended_mitigation: Upgrade the renderer base to patched HarfBuzz; keep text-size, render-time and concurrency limits. Do not exempt a reachable DoS merely because memory is capped.
image_cves.exploitation_review: KEV absence only; public-exploit/in-the-wild status is not exhaustively established
